newsitem.title: SPAIN: SPAIN SEES TELEPHONE SERVICE COST DROP SOON.
newsitem.headline: SPAIN SEES TELEPHONE SERVICE COST DROP SOON.

text.p: Spain's telephone service costs and tariffs will decrease in the near future after Telefonica's monopoly in basic services ends, Development Minister Rafael Arias-Salgado told journalists on Thursday.
"The prices of telephone services should decrease over the next few months," he said at the signing of an agreement between the state and second basic telephone service provider Retevision.
Spanish electricity utility Endesa and Italian telecoms operator Stet won a joint bid for Retevision last month and said they would start offering basic service by the end of the year.
The first connection -- between Madrid and Rome -- will be opened on Friday.
Arias-Salgado says the tariff cuts would most likely be on regional, inter-regional and international calls.
